description_en: Queries the model usage summary of DataAgent analysis tasks within a specified time range, including the number of models used, total call count, total tokens consumed, and peak TPM
description_zh: 查询指定时间范围内DataAgent分析任务的模型用量汇总，包括使用的模型数、调用总次数、消耗的Token总量以及峰值TPM
kebab_example: aliyun dms get-data-agent-task-model-usage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --begin-time 1735660800 --end-time 1735747200 --pay-level example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataAgentTaskModelUsage

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The recommended interval length is no longer than one month
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的开始时间，取值为Unix时间戳，单位为秒(建议区间长度不大于一月)
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The recommended interval length is no longer than one month
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的结束时间，取值为Unix时间戳，单位为秒(建议区间长度不大于一月)
parameters.name: end_time

Data.description_en: The summary data of model usage for DataAgent analysis tasks
Data.description_zh: DataAgent分析任务模型用量的汇总数据

peakTpm.description_en: The peak TPM (tokens per minute) within the query time range, which is the maximum number of tokens consumed per minute
peakTpm.description_zh: 本次查询范围内的峰值TPM，即每分钟消耗的最大Token数

totalCallCount.description_en: The total number of model calls within the query time range
totalCallCount.description_zh: 本次查询范围内的模型调用总次数

totalTokenConsumed.description_en: The total number of tokens consumed within the query time range
totalTokenConsumed.description_zh: 本次查询范围内消耗的Token总量

usedModels.description_en: The number of models used within the query time range
usedModels.description_zh: 本次查询范围内使用过的模型数量

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志、排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
